mcqs.q: Why did the British Empire end after WWII?
options: The UN forced Britain to grant independence to all colonies in 1945.
Britain voluntarily gave its colonies independence as a moral choice.
Britain was bankrupted by the war, faced rising nationalist movements, and confronted US/Soviet pressure against colonialism in a new world order.
Khrushchev placed missiles in Cuba because Castro asked him to invade Florida.

mcqs.q: Why did Khrushchev place missiles in Cuba in 1962?
options: Khrushchev placed missiles in Cuba to prepare for a nuclear first strike on the US.
To deter US invasion of Cuba, redress strategic missile imbalance (the US had missiles in Turkey), and bolster Soviet bargaining power — not as a first step in invading the US.
Magna Carta abolished the monarchy and created Parliament.
Khrushchev placed missiles in Cuba because Castro asked him to invade Florida.

mcqs.q: What did Magna Carta actually do in 1215?
options: Magna Carta abolished the monarchy and created Parliament.
Magna Carta gave ordinary English people democratic rights and freedom.
It was a peace treaty between King John and rebel barons protecting baronial privileges and limiting arbitrary royal taxation and imprisonment — it was annulled within months.
The UN forced Britain to grant independence to all colonies in 1945.
